# Atrax Docs

Atrax v0 is an agent-native CLI for public Cloudflare Worker apps with Static Assets and D1. Prefer the Markdown pages or docs.json when reading programmatically.

Agent onboarding command: `curl -fsSL https://tarantula-9l0.pages.dev/agent`

Deploy uses the caller's Cloudflare account. Without one, `atrax deploy --instant` returns `{ "schemaVersion": 1, "status": "deployed", "mode": "instant", "url": "...", "appId": "...", "access": "public", "claimToken": "...", "expiresAt": 1790000000000 }`; `access` is `public` or `shared` and the deploy says so in one line under the URL. The token is printed once and `atrax claim <token>` returns `{ "schemaVersion": 1, "status": "claimed", "appId": "...", "url": "..." }`. Unclaimed apps are deleted after 30 days. Shared apps and `atrax share` work on instant hosting too.
